foci.correctness: correctness and logic (control flow, error paths, edge cases, off-by-one)
foci.dataContract: data contracts (request and response shapes, type coercions, schema alignment with the clients that call this API)
foci.security: security and authorization (auth middleware, role checks, input validation, injection)
foci.performance: performance (N+1 queries, unnecessary DB calls, background job efficiency)
foci.errorHandling: error handling and observability (error types, logging, missing catch paths)
foci.migration: data integrity and migration safety (rollback, backfill, nullability, destructive DDL, data loss on migrate)

highRiskSurface: schema and migrations, auth, payments, mass delete/update
